events.name: The Ones You Left

success.text: You kneel by the log. Nobody asks you to hurry. Nobody looks away.

You dig a hole beside the fire, with your hands, and it takes longer than it should.

The notebook goes in. Your Pokémon stand around the little grave and watch, the way you watch a friend do something hard. Nobody says anything.

When you stand, they stand closer. Something is different, and none of you could say what.

events.name: The Ones You Left: The Balls
events.intro:
The notebook says who they were. The Balls say who they still are.

{left:first}

success.text: You lift the Ball. It is warm, as if someone has been holding it. The one inside steps out and leans against you without a word. It remembers one thing it knew then, and shows you.

remembers.notice: The one you took walks beside you, a little behind, the way it used to. It looks back once, at the camp, and then ahead.
The fresh earth is the only thing left to look at. Your Pokémon walk past it slowly, one at a time, and touch it.

success.text: You put out the last of the fire. The camp stays where it is. You do not turn around. Nobody there would want you to.

effects.text: Met the ones I left on this road, and let them choose.
